negative.message: The text slot requires an ordinary native VARCHAR with a character length.
negative.reason: A TEXT declaration cannot establish the supported length-bearing native VARCHAR role. It cannot supply that role to a complete projection, predicate or write destination.

assessment: Keep the same SQL, declarations, releases, positions, counts, finite bounds and required faults. The typed boundary replaces the old signed-only diagnostic for these four existing TEXT negatives. The generated-column witnesses on later releases remain identical.
